language-label: Label for the app-wide interface-language selector, not manuscript language.
language-save-failed: Visible failure after saving language preferences fails. The previous locale remains active.
language-load-failed: Startup warning when preferences cannot be read. Supported system language is used, otherwise English.
language-invalid-settings: Startup warning for malformed or unsupported saved preferences. The original file is not changed on load.
language-incomplete: Temporary Hebrew foundation notice: complete translation and RTL qualification are not yet finished.
language-incomplete-label: Disclosure summary for the temporary incomplete-Hebrew-support notice.
welcome-tagline: Welcome-screen description. Markdown is the file format name.
open-folder: Button that opens the native project-folder chooser.
view-write: Main writing view tab and native View menu command.
view-overview: Derived manuscript overview, distinct from the writer's free-form outline.
view-timeline: Timeline view tab and native menu command.
view-interactions: Character co-appearance view tab and native menu command.
close-project: Close the project and return to welcome; does not delete any files.
menu-undo: Standard native undo role; accelerator and behavior are retained.
menu-toggle-outline: Show/hide the writer's outline reading panel.
menu-about: Native About command/dialog title. Plot Device is an unchanged brand.
about-detail: Native About detail. $1 is the trusted app version, not user content. Keep license identifier and URL unchanged.
about-close: Dismiss About dialog, not the project or application.
about-project-page: Open the fixed public project URL in the external browser.
date-undated: Story-date reading with no value; also character birth dates.
date-unreadable: Short timeline tooltip summary when a date cannot be used. Detailed validation appears below the timeline.
date-invalid-short: Compact timeline column label for invalid dates.
date-undated-short: Compact timeline column label for absent dates.
date-missing: Explanation beside an undated chapter in the timeline tray.
date-without-usable: Heading for chapters whose story date is missing or invalid.
date-year-bce: $1 is the positive magnitude of a Gregorian year before year zero, ungrouped decimal digits. Keep the era distinct from the number. No automatic calendar conversion.
date-day-count: $1 is a signed, ungrouped story day number, not a Gregorian day of month. The number may be negative.
date-month-year: $1 is a translated month name (long in date descriptions, short on the axis); $2 is a formatted year, possibly with an era. Reorder the whole message as needed.
date-full: $1 is day of month, $2 a translated Gregorian month name, $3 a formatted year. Include any language-specific linking preposition here.
date-range: $1 and $2 are independently formatted date endpoints. Retain each endpoint's precision; do not reverse chronological order in RTL.
date-error-not-day-number: $1 is the unusable source value, bidi-isolated by the caller. Explain integer story-day input; 14 is an example.
date-error-too-large: $1 is the unusable source value, bidi-isolated by the caller; exceeds safe integer range.
date-error-not-date: $1 is the unusable source value, bidi-isolated by the caller. YYYY, YYYY-MM and YYYY-MM-DD are canonical input syntax, not localized dates.
date-error-invalid-month: $1 is the complete source date, bidi-isolated by the caller; $2 is its invalid numeric month.
date-error-invalid-day: $1 is the source date, bidi-isolated by the caller. The day does not exist in that Gregorian month/year.
date-month-1: Gregorian January, full month name. Not the Hebrew calendar.
date-month-short-1: Compact Gregorian January name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-2: Compact Gregorian February name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-3: Compact Gregorian March name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-4: Compact Gregorian April name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-5: Compact Gregorian May name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-6: Compact Gregorian June name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-7: Compact Gregorian July name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-8: Compact Gregorian August name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-9: Compact Gregorian September name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-10: Compact Gregorian October name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-11: Compact Gregorian November name for timeline ticks.
date-month-short-12: Compact Gregorian December name for timeline ticks.
